nonblocking_findings: Strengthen the cross-process lock test to assert the actual contention error.
Add explicit backward-compatibility coverage for manifests that predate coordinator_branch and state_revision.
Cover accepted-task reroute rejection and reject audit archival without its builder report.
Make interrupted auditor-reroute replay idempotent instead of duplicating routing evidence.

verification: 23 focused coordinator, Git-boundary, and cross-process lock tests passed.
npm run studio:coord -- validate passed for 19 tasks.

residual_risks: A crash-stale lock remains fail-closed and requires manual PID verification before removal.
The exclusive-create lock assumes local filesystem semantics; the coordinator worktree must not live on a network filesystem.
Direct library imports do not receive CLI mutation locks or branch guards; the supported mutation surface remains the CLI.
privacy_note: The first audit attempt was cancelled after it read an unrelated local output-style file. The completed audit used an isolated bundle containing only the authorized base/head coordinator files and verification summary.
